`astronaut.png` is the public-domain NASA test image distributed by scikit-image.
Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.21.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png
License/attribution: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut
It is used only to test local face bounding-box detection, without identity recognition.
